Half-Life 2: Versus

Earth remains under the iron grip of the Combine, and the Resistance fights a war it can barely sustain.

You're a rebel turned mercenary, taking high-risk contracts in quarantined City sectors and Xen-infested wastelands.

Hunt Combine patrols, clear out alien infestations, and extract with salvaged tech and black-market credits to upgrade your gear. The cause still lingers in your mind, but in a world ruled by the Combine, survival pays.
